entities.name: Tracking Area Update procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to update its tracking area information with the network.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by the UE to initiate the tracking area update procedure.

entities.name: EPS update type
entities.description: Information element included in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message indicating the type of update requested.

entities.name: Old GUTI
entities.description: Information element containing the previously allocated GUTI, included in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state in which the UE is registered with the network.

relations.description: The tracking area update procedure includes sending the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains the EPS update type information element.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains the old GUTI information element.
The tracking area update procedure requires the UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state.
